feature_under_test: bounded Recruiting Detail Offer, Claim, Result transactions and aggregate budget accounting

environment.database_identity: ephemeral non-root staircase_runtime and staircase_migrator accounts

implementation.offer: one bounded transaction prepares a valid prefix; no-candidate or budget-blocked terminates that prefix normally, while exceptional errors roll back before item-wise fallback
implementation.claim: one bounded atomic transaction persists each Attempt transition and command receipt independently; any member failure rolls the whole fast path back
implementation.result: one bounded atomic transaction persists each Work, Attempt, receipt, primary Artifact, supporting Artifacts and business result independently; any member failure rolls the whole fast path back before existing item-wise rejected-Artifact handling
implementation.budget: each Permit remains independently versioned while shared global, capability, origin, company, profile and workload usage is locked and adjusted once per dimension by the aggregate delta
implementation.fence: the Detail eligibility read also captures Company and Source configuration versions and execution fences under one shared configuration fence; Work placement is checked against that Company and Source domain
implementation.compatibility: default batch size remains one and all exceptional paths retain the established item-wise protocol

assessment.interpretation: the controlled single-four-core-host D3 slice crosses the arithmetic 400K-in-8h throughput reference; this is a sizing signal, not proof that 400K were executed or that production SLO is met

non_claims: actual execution of 20K simultaneous Listing occurrences and 400K Detail jobs
third-party latency, throttling, CDN, JavaScript or availability behavior
long-window production SLO or production readiness

acceptance.reason: the controlled single-host arithmetic reference is crossed, but the full external production-scale workload and long-window gates remain open
